app.name: Ora
app.summary: A big clock for the screensaver in your colours, with the weather's icon, two tones and a night colour.
app.saver_example: The time large in your colours, the date and 21° under it
app.digits_hint: The colour of the hours, and of the minutes unless you give them their own.
app.minutes_hint: Same as the hours, or a second colour for two tones.
app.boxes_hint: Graphite cards, cards tinted with the hours' colour, or a colour of their own. With Outline it is the line's colour.
app.style_hint: Flip cards, an outline around the digits, or plain digits with a colon.
app.size_hint: Large: side by side, as wide as the screen (best on a square or wide screen). Stacked: hours above minutes (best on a tall screen). Normal: the screen's own digit size.
app.date_format_hint: How the date under the clock is written, with or without the day's name, or no date.
app.temperature_hint: The colour of the temperature, of the row's icons and words, and of AM or PM.
app.night_hint: During the screen's night hours: the same colours, the same but dimmer, or one colour for the whole clock. It changes when the screensaver comes on.
app.seconds_hint: A dot (a colon in plain digits) that blinks every second.
app.row_hint: The entities you add to the Clock step's row (+ beside the clock): a weather entity shows its condition, sun, cloud or rain. Their icons, their icons and words, or nothing.
